stories.title: Define Clinical Trials Search Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define request and response schema for clinical trials search including condition, location, recruiting status, eligibility summary, structured trial metadata, and optional travel metrics.

stories.title: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov Search Logic
stories.description: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov API integration with recruiting filter, condition/location query handling, structured parsing of trial data, eligibility summary normalization, and trial site extraction.

stories.title: Add Travel Distance and Time Enrichment
stories.description: Add optional travel distance and duration enrichment using Google Routes API based on user location and trial sites, executed only when user location is provided.

stories.title: Expose Clinical Trials Search via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Expose clinical trials search via EvaluateCare facade and tool router with validated inputs, structured output, and compatibility with chat tool-use patterns.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering API fetch, parsing, eligibility normalization, travel enrichment, facade-level response validation, and error handling scenarios.
